answer: Neighbor-weighted degree reconciliation: an agent’s influence is capped by the diversity of its distinct neighbors’ regions, measured against an opal-like minority fraction of shared contacts. Each region must maintain a willow-thin bridge count to others, so adding a fake peer in one place demands real, non-clustered links elsewhere. The karst rule requires every neighbor to route a challenge through an independent channel, charging the attacker a full round-trip per fabricated identity.
